title: Butter Yellow Tee & Plaid Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight copper-red hair and freckles stands against a soft gray wall. She wears a butter-yellow long-sleeve fitted top with a scoop neck and a small script graphic, plus a thin silver pendant necklace. Below, a brown houndstooth pleated mini skirt with a brown leather belt, and tall taupe knee-high socks. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even daylight, a palette of butter yellow, warm brown, and camel. Playful and preppy, in the style of a Y2K-inspired fashion catalog.
